articles.text: Starbucks (SBUX) Introduces Worker Bonuses And Weekly Pay In Frontline Overhaul. Starbucks (NasdaqGS:SBUX) is rolling out a new bonus program and pay structure for cafe workers. The company indicates these changes could lift hourly pay by roughly 5% to 8%. For investors tracking Starbucks, this pay overhaul sits at the intersection of operations, labor relations, and brand strength. The company runs a large global cafe network...

articles.text: Starbucks (SBUX) Is Replacing Microsoft And IBM Software To Cut $400 Million Spend. The overhaul is aimed at gaining more control over operations and could influence how other global consumer brands approach enterprise technology.
